content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text marks Isaiah 7:14 UNDERDETERMINED on the stated ground that [CR2] leaves the sign's sense open, which is the single-verse/double-sense ground the rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand — read as barring UNDERDETERMINED when a verse is open/two-sense, versus read as permitting UNDERDETERMINED if the sign's sense remains unresolved.","why":"The rule says a two-sense verse is not open and both senses stand, so an open sense cannot support UNDERDETERMINED."}
